item.title: IMB Sending Celebration highlights generosity, missionaries’ testimonies
item.description: Southern Baptists gathered at First Baptist Rogers of Rogers, Arkansas, Wednesday, Feb. 4 to support and send 41 International Mission Board missionaries who are going to the nations to share the gospel of Jesus Christ.

item.title: IMB’s Paul Chitwood highlights strategic priorities for next 5 years
item.description: International Mission Board trustees approved the appointment of 41 new full-time, fully funded missionaries during their Feb. 4–5 meeting. IMB President Paul Chitwood announced the IMB’s five strategic priorities for the next five years.

item.title: ‘He Gets Us’ campaign returns for 2026 Super Bowl
item.description: A new take on the campaign will focus on dealing with the struggles of life, rather than social conflicts.

item.title: ‘Elder statesman of youth ministry’ points students to life-changing truths
item.description: At 60 years old, evangelist Douglas Runkles – better known as “Runks” – considers himself the “elder statesman of youth ministry.”

item.title: Winter Olympic Games: Missionaries ready to serve
item.description: Baptist missionaries will make the most of this unique moment in the coming days, with hundreds of volunteers joining forces alongside International Mission Board missionaries to proclaim Christ boldly throughout the city.
